children: Fox News has parted ways with longtime anchor Maria Bartiromo, the cable news network said Thursday.
The network said in a news release that the journalist is no longer with Fox News Media, effective today.
Bartiromo had not been on Fox News or Fox Business for almost a month.
"We thank Maria for her work over the last 12 1/2 years and wish her all the best on her next chapter," Fox News said in a statement.
Bartiromo didn't immediately respond to a request for comment.
Fox Corp. and Wall Street Journal parent News Corp share common ownership.
